story.originalTitle: Kimi is feeling under the weather today as he recovers from a viral illness. As a precaution, the FIA has excused him from his mandatory media duties ...
story.summaryEn: Kimi is feeling under the weather today as he recovers from a viral illness. As a precaution, the FIA has excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest ahead of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow.
detailZh: 基米因病毒感染身体不适，国际汽联免除他参加媒体任务的义务，以让他有机会在周末前休息。我们预计他将在明天恢复。
detailEn: Kimi is feeling under the weather today as he recovers from a viral illness. As a precaution, the FIA has excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest ahead of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow.
story.leadZh: 基米因病毒感染身体不适，国际汽联免除其媒体任务，预计他将在明天恢复。
bodyZh: 基米因病毒感染身体不适，国际汽联免除其媒体任务，预计他将在明天恢复。
